description.value: Britannia Branch is a public branch of the Vancouver Public Library serving the Grandview-Woodland neighbourhood. As a publicly operated library, it offers free access to books, digital resources, and community programming. For touring cyclists passing through East Vancouver, it represents a free, welcoming rest stop in a well-serviced urban neighbourhood.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 11m; rack at 24m; rack at 64m; stands (4 spaces) at 99m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch returned only a Cloudflare bot-verification page, so no actual site content is available; I must rely solely on OSM tags. OSM confirms a public library operated by Vancouver Public Library with tags for wheelchair accessibility, wheelchair-accessible toilets (toilets:wheelchair=yes), and Wi-Fi (internet_access=wlan), but per the rules these OSM amenity tags cannot be treated as authoritative without website corroboration. The record shows no indication of closure and has valid opening hours and contact data.
concerns: Website fetch blocked by Cloudflare security verification — actual site content was unavailable; all amenity fields rely on OSM tags only and could not be confirmed.
OSM tags internet_access=wlan and toilets:wheelchair=yes suggest Wi-Fi and accessible washrooms, but these could not be confirmed via website content due to the fetch failure.
pre_enrichment_exclude flag was set to true with reason 'prefetch_failed_stub'; record is otherwise valid and should be included.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating public library branch with valid OSM data, opening hours, and no indication of closure. Free public access makes it useful to touring cyclists as a rest stop.

wow_evidence: Neighbourhood VPL branch; library ladder 1/1. Distinct institution within Britannia campus, kept separate from CC record.
blurb: Vancouver Public Library branch on the Britannia community campus.
